description: Click the conservation patches on the current window to inspect the hidden glass pieces; each exposed piece stays visible when it moves. Restore the thirteen glass pieces to the reference. Start the collars. A disc may turn only when it contains the heart and no foreign point. Turn while its fixed notch straddles the fixed brass pin. The fixed open decision layout stays unchanged while waiting, dragging, holding, or inspecting and advances after each accepted turn; after the finite action window, the closed guard is shown. A closed-collar turn cracks the window. Shape-blocked probes are harmless. Seal only the restored window. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or other hidden-state access.
